scope: Measure photographic interpolation support and source-pixel boundary distances. This is diagnostic metadata only: no mask, feature, objective or acceptance changes.
measurements: Exact bilinear tap weight inside the crop quadrilateral
Exact bilinear tap weight inside the source image
Source-pixel distance to each crop edge
Per-feature minimum and tenth-percentile distance, minimum observed weight and fraction of affected pixels
flags: Any positive interpolation weight comes from beyond the crop
Any feature pixel is within one source pixel of the crop boundary
controls: All original feature and source-error criteria remain unchanged. Flags are not instructions to remove features.
